integrity: The universal positivity and largest-weight statements are proved analytically from the Lagrange coefficient formula, grid nesting, and a strict adjacent-magnitude inequality. Exact-rational computation checks representative and finite families only as corroboration. A nonnested exact counterexample marks the scope boundary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a strict integer divisibility chain of uniform trapezoidal grids and exact Richardson coefficients.
It is a sufficient positivity theorem, not a classification of all division sequences with positive extrapolation weights.
It concerns exact collected weights and bounded absolute sample errors, not floating-point cancellation in a recursive extrapolation tableau.
title: Positive-weight Richardson–Romberg quadrature on every nested integer refinement chain
